'''House Raned''' is one of the known minor [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Andor]].

The only known member of the House is Lady [[Daerilla Raned]]. She initially fawns over [[Rand al'Thor]] after he takes control in [[Andor]], but ends up supporting [[Naean Arawn]] for the [[Lion Throne]] over [[Elayne Trakand]].

==Notes==
In the Companion, it is spelled Raened, but Raned is the spelling in the books.
